title: DevBoy Token Catalog v1
description: Per-provider token catalog file. One file = one provider. Each provider declares N variants (regions, tiers, subscriptions); each variant has its own retrieval URL, regex, liveness probe, and step-by-step guide. Shipped as `~/.devboy/secrets/catalog/<provider>.json`.

schema_version.description: Pinned to 1 for this schema. Future major bumps will fail to load on older builds; minor changes go through optional fields.

provider_id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Matches the filename without extension (e.g. `kimi.json` → `kimi`).

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the variant picker.

description.description: Short description shown above the variant list. Optional.

env_var_patterns.description: Env-var → variant patterns the `setup-secrets` proposer (devboy-cli) consults to map a scanned env-var name to an ADR-020 path. Optional and additive.

env_var_skip.description: Env-var names this provider asks the proposer to skip outright (configuration toggles like `<PROVIDER>_BASE_URL` that look like credentials at first glance). Globs use `*` as a single-segment wildcard.

matches.description: One or more env-var names. Bare names are matched literally; names with `*` are globs (single underscore segment per `*`).

variant.description: Variant id (must exist in the same catalog's `variants` list) the matched env-var maps to.

scope.description: ADR-020 scope segment for the resulting path.

id.description: Stable identifier scoped to the provider, e.g. `kimi-cn`, `kimi-global`, `kimi-coding`.

format_regex.description: Rust-flavored regex the value must match (use anchors). Optional.

format_hint.description: Human-readable shape hint, e.g. `sk- + 32 alnum`. Independent of `format_regex` so the user sees something readable even when the regex is gnarly.

default_keychain_account.description: When the user opts to store via OS keychain, this overrides the default `account = path` convention. Useful for legacy providers that already have an established keychain entry name.

console_url.description: Provider's console / settings URL — the creation page. The `Open URL` button in the provision dialog points here.

docs_url.description: Provider's official documentation for this credential — scopes, security best practices, auth model. Distinct from `console_url` (where you make the key). Optional; the dialog renders a 'Provider docs' link when present.

steps.description: Numbered procedure the user follows on the console UI.

notes.description: Free-form gotchas / scope requirements / billing caveats.

kind.description: Currently always `http`. Reserved tag for future probe kinds.

guide_url.description: Provider's rotation / key-hygiene guide. Optional — many providers have no dedicated page, in which case `notes` carries the procedure. The dialog renders a 'Rotation guide' link when present.

notes.description: Concrete rotation procedure / caveats — the 'how', not the 'when'. E.g. atomic pair rotation, reinstall-after-scope-change, overlap window. Rendered as a block in the dialog's rotation section.
